about.title: About Clovekeep
about.subtitle: A handy recipe book for everyday cooking, smart importing, and effortless personal adaptation.
about.missionText: We wanted a calm, clutter-free kitchen companion where favorite dishes live cleanly without pop-ups, ads, or mental math when scaling portions.
about.featureScaler: Instant portion scaling with clean rounded numbers and metric/imperial unit switching.
about.featureImport: Smart AI import from culinary websites, social captions, or recipe screenshots.
about.featureCooking: Focused Cooking Mode with screen wake lock and built-in step timers.
about.featureCollections: Personal collections, saved bookmarks, drafts, and private forks to adapt recipes to your taste.
about.openSourceText: Clovekeep is developed openly on GitHub. Browse the source code, suggest features, or report issues anytime.
